what: The "stalled" chip compared a lift's nights across gyms, so five lifts climbing at New York (Push B chest press, high-to-low crossover, straight-arm pulldown, reverse curl, seated row) were labelled stalled against numbers from Warsaw, Singapore and Chennai.
consequence: A wrong label on five cards he trains from; on 15 November he wrote "Wtf why are you saying stalled?!?!".

what: His phone's phase has been locked by hand to Meso 3 since at least 28 October (every log stamped meso3, weeks 5 to 9). validate-coach requires a packet's review.block.phase to equal the calendar's phase, and the app sets aside any packet whose phase type differs from a locked phase. In a calendar deload, assessment or prep week, no packet the trainer is allowed to commit can reach his card, and the app runs its own build progression instead.
where: js/engine.js coachPhaseMatches / coachPhaseFor; scripts/validate-coach.mjs block.phase check; settings.phaseOverride
consequence: From 25 November the daily review stopped reaching his card: the 25 November lighter-week numbers were set aside (he trained the app's build card), and while the lock stays the same holds for assessment (2 to 8 December) and all of prep (from 9 December). Tonight the app's own card asks a 5 lb crossover jump (12.5 to 17.5) and 10 lb neck flexion on a never-done lift.

what: The guide sheet (tap the lift name on the card) reads store.plan.exercises, the original lift list from plan.json, instead of the live plan that merges program.json exercises. Every lift the trainer added through program.exercises shows "No field guide for this one." even though its howto is written: plate-neck-flexion, plate-neck-extension, db-overhead-triceps-extension, ab-crunch-machine.
where: js/views/session.js howtoSheet (const meta = store.plan?.exercises[exId]); the same raw read sits at session.js line 655 for the bodyweight check
consequence: On 27 November he did neck flexion for the first time with no instructions on the card and wrote "No field guide?". Any lift the trainer adds from outside the catalogue reaches him with no form guide.
